Chapter 724 - 724 Pursuit Again; Revenge!

Chapter 724 - 724 Pursuit Again; Revenge!

724 Pursuit Again; Revenge!

When everyone heard this, they all revealed a hint of joy.

Over the years, Hu Tian, Xia Xue, Xia Bing, Su Ningjing, and the others had been cultivating hard.

In the beginning, they felt a little bored.

However, as time passed, they all liked the feeling of cultivation.

Gradually, they began to compete with each other.

Now that Lin Fan was able to help them solve their cultivation problems, wouldn’t that allow them to have a faster cultivation speed?

Of course they would be happy.

As for Li Ke, Qin Menghu, Zheng Cong, Song Wenxuan, and Riemann, there was no need to mention them.

The thing that they had been looking forward to was to meet Lin Fan and receive his guidance.

Now, it could finally become reality.

Hu Tian was the first to raise a question, and Lin Xiaoyao followed closely behind.

Then, it was Huang Ling, Su Ningjing, Han Tian…

The lecture lasted for a full month before it came to an end.

Hu Tian, Xia Xue, Xia Bing, Su Ningjing, and everyone else had a look of understanding on their faces.

Some people even directly broke through to a minor realm.

….

Time flew by like water.

In the blink of an eye, a year had passed.

Lin Fan had just woken up from his cultivation and gave Tai Jun a curse as usual.

….

Ten Thousand Demon Sect.

“Roar!”

Tai Jun roared at the sky. The entire palace shook violently as if it would collapse at any moment.

His eyes were scarlet red, and black gas surged like a fountain. His entire body fluctuated between large and small, and he was constantly distorted as if he was about to explode at any moment.

He leaped and arrived before a tall stone statue. He bowed and said,””Ancestor, I’m cursed. Please save me!”

“Roar!”

Tai Jun roared again, causing the stone statue to shake.

In the next moment…

The stone statue suddenly blinked its eyes, and then, it emitted a dazzling golden light.

“Hmm? Curse?”

The surging energy quickly surged into Tai Jun’s body.

Not long after, he calmed down.

“This item can help you resist the curse.”

Then, a fist-sized pearl landed in front of Tai Jun.

“Thank you, Old Ancestor!” Tai Jun hurriedly said.

“Whoosh!”

The golden light around the stone statue faded, and everything returned to normal.

Tai Jun held the bead with a smile on his face.

….

Three years passed in the blink of an eye.

On this day, Lin Fan first checked his character relationships. He realized that no one’s name was flashing or that they were in danger. His heart calmed down a little.

Then, he used soul communication with Qiu Ziqian and Lin Yulian.

“Lin Fan!”

“Daddy!”

They were both very happy.

When Lin Fan heard their voices, he felt a sense of familiarity.

“Dad, I’m already at the Stellar Level 9!”Lin Yulian said excitedly.

He looked like a child who had achieved good results and was waiting for his parents to praise him.

Lin Fan praised,” Really?” Good job!”

“Hehe!” Lin Yulian said.

Lin Fan continued,” You haven’t encountered any trouble recently, right?”

“Sigh, don’t mention it! I don’t know what went wrong with the Ten Thousand Demon Sect in the past two years, but they’ve been hunting us down again. Mom and I only came to a safe place two days ago…” Lin Yulian sighed.

When Lin Fan heard that, his heart tightened and he asked,””Pursue you again? Are you injured?”

Qiu Ziqian could hear Lin Fan’s worry and quickly said,””Don’t worry, we’re fine…”

The family chatted for a while more before ending their soul communication.

Lin Fan asked the System,” Why are Qiu Ziqian and Lin Yulian being chased by the Ten Thousand Demon Sect again?” Also, I’ve cursed Taijun for so long. Why hasn’t he died yet?”

After all, he had once cursed Zhu Yan, who was also a Martial Monarch Realm expert, to death. It had only been ten years.

However, it had been almost 10 years since the curse had been cast. Other than the system notification a few years ago that Tai Jun’s inner demon had increased greatly, there had been no other news.

[Requires 10 million spirit stones. Do you wish to inquire?]

When Lin Fan heard this, he raised his brows.

One question, 10 million spirit stones?

This was definitely the most expensive problem at the moment.

However, he did not hesitate and said,””Inquire!”

[Taijun obtained the help of his ancestor, Holy Master Taixu, and gave him a defensive magic treasure to resist a certain amount of the curse power.]

Lin Fan frowned,”Great Void?” Did it block a certain curse? Then I’d like to see how much it can block!”

Thus, Lin Fan gave Tai Jun a curse set once again.

“Thump! Thump!”

As soon as he finished cursing, there was a knock on the door.

Lin Fan looked up and saw that it was Li Ke. He said,””Come in.”

“Creak!”

As soon as he finished speaking, the door opened automatically.

After Li Ke walked in, he knelt on the ground and said,”Greetings, Master.”

Lin Fan nodded,” What is it?”

Li Ke hesitated for a moment before saying,””Master, I want to go out for a while. I want revenge for killing my parents!”

When he said this, his face revealed a thick hatred.

In fact, this was also the reason why he had come to the Coiling Dragon Villa back then.

He had to take revenge for his parents!

Lin Fan could feel the hatred as well,””Go ahead.”

“Thank you, Master!” Li Ke kowtowed to the ground and slowly retreated.

Then, his figure flashed and appeared directly outside the Coiling Dragon Villa without attracting anyone’s attention.

Li Ke looked back at Coiling Dragon Villa, his eyes full of respect.

Then, he turned around and looked towards the north. His eyes were filled with endless anger.

There…It was in the direction of the enemy.

“Whoosh!”

He leaped up like a rocket and soared into the sky.

….

In a slightly old courtyard.

The emaciated little girl was locked in the cage like an animal. She could not help but tremble and sob,”Daddy, where are you? Xiao Qin was so cold and hungry…Wuuu…”

The woman in high heels and black leather shoes grinned and said,”Are you still thinking about that damned father? Let me tell you, he died a long time ago! Otherwise, he would have given her a good name! Li Ke? Haha!

Curse father, curse mother, curse the whole family! Hahaha!”

“Yo yo yo! Hungry? Alright! There are some rotten buns prepared to feed the dogs. Eat them to your heart’s content!”

After saying that, she opened the cage and poured a large pile of rotten steamed buns into it.

The pungent smell made one feel nauseous.

“Whoosh!”

Unbeknownst to the woman, a man suddenly descended from the sky and appeared behind her.

He was Li Ke.

This house used to be Li Ke’s home.

Before Li Ke took revenge, he came over to take a look, but he heard a little girl being locked in a cage.

It was not difficult to see a pair of big black eyes and a high nose bridge on the little girl’s gray face.

Li Ke realized that her appearance seemed to be somewhat similar to his.

Just as Li Ke was puzzled, the woman said,””Are you still thinking about that damned father? Let me tell you, he died a long time ago! Or should he say that his name was good, Li Ke? Haha! Curse father, curse mother, curse the whole family!

Hahaha!”

Li Ke?

This girl was…His own child?
